description: The GOG Galaxy SDK as the game's games backend on Windows and macOS: the GOG player, achievements (with steps kept in stats) and leaderboards. It links the developer's own copy of the GOG Galaxy SDK, found through GOG_GALAXY_SDK, with the game's client from the environment.

GOG_GALAXY_CLIENT_ID.description: The game's Galaxy SDK client id, from its page in the GOG Developer Portal.

GOG_GALAXY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The client's secret, from the same page. GOG expects it to ship in the game.

name: galaxy
